title: Bounce Path Multiplayer
description: Guide a bouncing ball toward its destination by placing and adjusting obstacles. Play solo or compare solutions with friends across a series of quick physics-based puzzles.
controls: Choose solo or multiplayer, then drag obstacles with the mouse or touch controls to shape the ball's path.

title: Ninja Parkour Multiplayer
description: Race other players through a fast 2D obstacle course. Precise jumps and steady movement matter more than combat as everyone tries to reach the finish first.
controls: Use W or Up Arrow to jump, A or Left Arrow to move left, and D or Right Arrow to move right. Create a room, join one, or enter matchmaking.

title: Multiplayer Pong
description: Play a streamlined online version of the classic paddle game. Join public matchmaking or create a private room and keep the ball away from your side.
controls: Move the mouse to control your paddle. Press Escape to return to the title screen.

title: Darts Pro Multiplayer
description: Compete in a browser-based game of darts and work from 501 points down to exactly zero. Careful aim and well-timed throws reward consistent play.
controls: Align your aim with the mouse or touch controls, then click or tap to throw. Target doubles and the bullseye while planning an exact finish.

title: Master Checkers Multiplayer
description: Play a modern browser version of checkers against an online opponent, the computer, or a friend sharing the same device. Plan captures and protect each move as the board opens up.
controls: Click or tap a piece, then select the square where it should move. Choose multiplayer, computer, or local friend mode from the game menu.

title: Tic Tac Toe Pro - Multiplayer Challenge
description: Take turns placing marks and try to complete a line before your opponent. This lightweight multiplayer challenge is designed for quick strategic matches.
controls: Select an empty square with the mouse or touch controls. Take turns placing marks and block your opponent while building your own line.

title: Nightmare Runners
description: Race through a nighttime obstacle course filled with traps, monsters, and rival runners. Play against online or computer-controlled opponents, or share one keyboard with a friend in local two-player mode.
controls: Solo: move with WASD or the Arrow Keys and jump with Space. Two players: Player 1 uses WASD and G to jump; Player 2 uses the Arrow Keys and L to jump.

title: Gang Fall Party
description: Knock rivals from elevated arenas in quick cartoon-style party battles. Fight a friend in local one-on-one mode, join larger online matches, or combine two-player controls with the Vs All challenge.
controls: Player 1 moves with WASD, runs with C, and punches with V. Player 2 moves with the Arrow Keys, runs with O, and punches with P.

title: Castle Wars: Legacy
description: Build a tactical deck, defend your castle, and break through an opponent's walls in fast turn-based duels. Play online against friends, enter tournaments, tackle the campaign, or practice against AI.
controls: Click or tap cards and menu options to spend resources, summon units, cast spells, and strengthen your castle during each turn.

title: Carrom Pro
description: Play a polished browser version of carrom with realistic collisions and several rule sets. Choose classic carrom, fast Disc Pool, or point-based Freestyle, then compete through local pass-and-play multiplayer.
controls: Drag to position the striker, pull back to set its direction and power, then release to shoot. Pot your pieces before your opponent according to the selected mode.

title: Turkish Draughts
description: Play the Turkish form of draughts, where pieces move and capture horizontally or vertically instead of diagonally. Challenge AI, share one device with another player, or compete with an online opponent.
controls: Click or tap a piece, then choose a valid horizontal or vertical destination. Capture opposing pieces and promote your draughts while protecting your own position.
